lesson: The system is consistently attempting to catch 'bullish pullbacks' into overextended, blow-off top structures, effectively front-running distribution phases. By ignoring the Wyckoff distribution patterns and RSI exhaustion, the strategy is consistently buying into liquidity traps rather than waiting for structural support retests.
adjustment: Mandate a minimum 15% price retracement from the local peak before considering a long entry, regardless of the higher timeframe bullish bias.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI overbought signals more as a primary filter for trend exhaustion rather than secondary confirmation.
